description: A minecraft mod for Fabric that allows you to mine blocks with one mining action.

mods.name: One Key Miner
mods.description: This mod helps mine ore or other blocks by mining blocks in a chain reaction.

releases.notes:
## 🆕Features

- Show the name and the description of every setting in the language of the game, in Chinese and English,
  like the name of every shape
- Draw the rows of the tool lists with the icon and the name the game shows for a block, and name the
  shapes that have no icon
- Complete a block id per segment, so `stone` completes to `minecraft:stone` just like vanilla, in the
  screen and in the commands, where a value written without a namespace is the one of the default one

## 🐛Bug fixes

- Complete the tool lists from the blocks of the game, they used to offer the enchantments of the game
- Reset a tool list restores the blocks it was built with instead of clearing it
